reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and a paper pendant that big is the kind of thing that arrives dented or looks different from the photos. I'd save it to my dining room board and keep looking at brands I already know.
objection: If it shows up crushed or just looks cheap in my room, I pay return shipping on a huge boxed fixture and it eats the savings. Free shipping in but not out, from a store I can't vouch for, is a lot of risk on $360.
would_change_my_mind: Free returns, or a prepaid return label for anything damaged or not as pictured. Real customer photos and reviews of the pendant hanging in actual homes would help too.
